siis_response.title: Cracked or bleeding screen on Galaxy phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Mobile Accessories,Smartphone,Tablet,Others Mobile Cracked or bleeding screen on Galaxy phone or tablet ( Mobile Accessories,Smartphone,Tablet,Others Mobile): # Service Options for Cracked Screens
We understand that dealing with a cracked screen can be frustrating. Here are the service options available to help you get your Samsung device repaired:
## Samsung Repair Services
You can schedule a walk-in or mail-in repair to fix your cracked screen using Samsung genuine parts. Visit Samsung Repair Services for more information.
## Samsung Authorized Service Centers
For fast, quality repairs you can trust and rely on, visit a local Samsung Authorized Service Center. You can learn more about the cost of the repair.
## Samsung Premium Care
If you have a Samsung Premium Care service contract, it covers accidental damage from handling with a low deductible. This service extends protection after your standard warranty runs out, providing coverage for repairs or replacements. Terms and Conditions apply. Learn more at Samsung Premium Care.
## Understanding Screen Damage
There are a few common ways screens can be damaged:
### Cracked Screen
Obvious cracks on the screen usually result from an impact to the front of the device.
### Ink Blots
If your device shows a round spot of dead pixels, it might have experienced gradual pressure that kept the front glass intact but damaged the screen underneath.
### Bleeding Pixels
Bleeding pixels are typically caused by an impact to the edge of the device. This can result in rows or columns of pixels displaying black or oddly colored lines.
